# Nexudyam

> Nexudyam is a digital marketing, website development, and branding agency helping startups, MSMEs, and creators build brand identity, run paid advertising, develop high-performance websites, and grow online.

Based in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India, Nexudyam offers professional digital marketing packages tailored for small businesses and growing creators.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.nexudyam.in/): Overview of services, agency philosophy, and client success stories.
- [About Us](https://www.nexudyam.in/about): Mission, history, and the vision of Nexudyam for next-generation entrepreneurship.
- [Pricing](https://www.nexudyam.in/pricing): Details of affordable digital marketing and branding packages starting at ₹4,999/month.
- [Blog](https://www.nexudyam.in/blog): SEO content hub and actionable guides on digital marketing, local SEO, and business growth.
- [Contact](https://www.nexudyam.in/contact): Communication channels including WhatsApp (+91-9161881100), phone, and inquiry form.

## Services

- [Services Hub](https://www.nexudyam.in/services): Overview of all digital marketing, branding, and web development offerings.
- [Website Development in Kanpur](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/website-development-kanpur): Custom, fast-loading business websites built on Next.js and WordPress with on-page SEO.
- [Google Business Profile in Kanpur](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/google-business-profile-kanpur): Setup, verification, optimization, and local review strategy for Google Maps 3-Pack ranking.
- [Meta & Google Ads in Kanpur](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/meta-google-ads-kanpur): Targeted Instagram, Facebook, and Google Search advertising management for local lead generation.
- [Brand Identity in Kanpur](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/brand-identity-kanpur): Custom logo design, brand guidelines, typography hierarchies, and vector assets.
- [Social Media Marketing in Kanpur](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/social-media-marketing-kanpur): Monthly content calendars, Instagram Reels scripts, graphics, and community engagement.
- [AI Content Marketing](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/ai-content-marketing): Fast video scripts, WhatsApp broadcast copy, and SEO blog writing with human review.
- [E-commerce Websites (Shopify)](https://www.nexudyam.in/ecom-websites): Custom Shopify store setup, payment gateway integration, and conversion optimization for MSMEs.
- [Artist Management](https://www.nexudyam.in/artist-management): Brand building, booking management, and growth strategy for creators and artists in UP.
- [Event Promotion](https://www.nexudyam.in/events): Pre-event ads, live coverage coordination, and evergreen post-event content repurposing.
